dct_title_s: A new map of the East India Isles: from the latest authorities
dct_alternative_sm: A new map of the East India Isles: from the latest authorities
dct_description_sm: Relief shown pictorially and by hachures.; Large detailed map of Southeast Asia, from John Cary's atlas. Extends from Mergui Archipelago, Straits of Malacca, and Sumatra to Papua New Guinea, Pelew Islands, and part of Formosa. -- Dealer's description.; Library's copy is backed with archival tissue and laid onto a larger flat archival sheet. Published by J. Cary, engraver & map-seller, No. 181 Strand (London)
